lines.en: label day340:
scene mollytsuneyoproposal1
So-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: I was just minding my own business and walking down the hallway when this person showed up.
lines.zh: 我正老老实实走自己的路，沿着走廊走着，这个人就冒了出来。

lines.en: She seems suspicious, so I avert my gaze and continue to move down the hallway toward my next destination- anywhere but here.
lines.zh: 她看起来很可疑，于是我移开视线，继续沿走廊朝下一个目的地前进——除了这里，哪儿都行。

lines.en: : Move.
lines.zh: : 让开。

lines.en: : No can do, Sir! The Kendo Princess has been practicing all day for this moment!
lines.zh: : 办不到，长官！剑道公主为了这一刻已经练习整整一天了！

lines.en: : Tsuneyo isn’t here.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 不在这儿。

lines.en: : The Kendo Princess is {i}always{/i} here, Sir.
lines.zh: : 剑道公主{i}永远{/i}都在这儿，长官。

lines.en: I scan the hallway for any sign of the noodle warrior and find nothing.
lines.zh: 我扫视走廊，寻找那位面条武士的任何踪迹，却什么也没找到。

lines.en: : Molly, she isn’t here.
lines.zh: : Molly，她不在这儿。

lines.en: : Shhhhh...trust in me and you shall see.
lines.zh: : 嘘……相信我，你就等着瞧吧。

lines.en: : No. Please move. I don’t have time for this.
lines.zh: : 不行。请让开。我没时间陪你闹。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal2
: What else can you possibly have to do, Sir? The[school] day is over and we haven’t taken a test in...ever. So there shouldn’t even be anything to grade.
lines.zh: : 您还能有什么别的事要做呢，长官？[school]的一天已经结束了，而且我们……从来没考过试。所以连要批改的东西都不该有。

lines.en: : The day being over means I have doors to knock on.
lines.zh: : 一天结束了，意味着我还有门要敲。

lines.en: : Which is fine, but at least let us give you our proposal first.
lines.zh: : 那没问题，但至少先让我们把提案说完。

lines.en: : You know, I’d be completely okay with that if-
lines.zh: : 你知道，如果——我完全没意见

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal1
: What’s that? You want me to start without her? I suppose that is fine as well!
lines.zh: : 什么？您要我不等她就开始？我觉得那也没问题！

lines.en: : Molly, please.
lines.zh: : Molly，拜托。

lines.en: : Prepare for trouble!
lines.zh: : 准备好迎接麻烦吧！

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal3
: Make it two times the amount of trouble.
lines.zh: : 把麻烦变成两倍的量。

lines.en: : How did-
lines.zh: : 你怎么——

lines.en: : To protect the world from devastation!
lines.zh: : 为了保护世界免于毁灭！

lines.en: : To unite all noodles within our nation.
lines.zh: : 为了将全国所有的面条团结起来。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal4
: To denounce the evils of truth and love!
lines.zh: : 为了揭穿真实与爱的邪恶！

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal5
: To reach up really high and attempt to grab stuff!
lines.zh: : 为了把手伸得高高的、试图去抓东西！

lines.en: : Molly!
lines.zh: : Molly！

lines.en: : Ramen!
lines.zh: : Ramen！

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal6
: Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!
lines.zh: : 火箭队，以光速飞出去吧！

lines.en: : Surrender now or prepare to face the consequences for your actions, bro!
lines.zh: : 现在投降，否则就为你的行为承担后果吧，老兄！

lines.en: : Meow~
: Did anyone hear a cat just now?
lines.zh: : 刚才有人听见猫叫吗？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal7
: See?! How awesome was that?!
lines.zh: : 看到了吗？！刚才那有多帅？！

lines.en: : It was wonderful. I particularly enjoyed the part where Tsuneyo materialized out of thin air.
lines.zh: : 精彩极了。我尤其喜欢 Tsuneyo 凭空出现的那一段。

lines.en: : Now, would you mind explaining to me what the meaning of this is?
lines.zh: : 那么，能麻烦你解释一下这到底是什么意思吗？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal8
: We’re going to sleep with you!
lines.zh: : 我们要和你睡觉！

lines.en: : At your house!
lines.zh: : 在你家！

lines.en: : If you two wanted a threesome, you really didn’t have to put on a skit for it. You could have just asked.
lines.zh: : 如果你们俩想要三人行，真用不着为此演一出短剧。你们直接问就行了。

lines.en: : What is a threesome? It sounds delicious.
lines.zh: : 三人行是什么？听起来很好吃。

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 确实好吃。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal9
: Wha...no. That’s not what I’m talking about. I just meant that we’re going to be sleeping over your house for a manga club thing in the near future and we wanted to ask for permission.
lines.zh: : 啥……不是。我说的不是那个意思。我是说，不久的将来我们要为漫画社的事去你家过夜，我们想先征求许可。

lines.en: : Molly, I’m sure that you have consumed enough pornography in your life to understand why your initial phrasing of this made me assume sex was involved.
lines.zh: : Molly，我敢肯定你这辈子看的色情作品已经够多了，足以明白你最初那种措辞为什么会让我以为跟性有关。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal10
: Misunderstandings are a pinnacle of h-games and people would lose interest if I did not occasionally hint at the prospect of threesomes!
lines.zh: : 误会是 H 游戏的精髓所在，如果我不时不时暗示一下三人行的可能性，大家可是会失去兴趣的！

lines.en: : I would also like to try a threesome.
lines.zh: : 我也想试试三人行。

lines.en: : Can you text that to me so I have it in writing?
lines.zh: : 你能把这句话发短信给我吗？我想留个书面的证据。

lines.en: : I don’t think I am allowed to exchange numbers with boys. I am sorry.
lines.zh: : 我想我是不被允许和男生交换号码的。抱歉。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Molly can text it to me instead.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Molly 可以代你发给我。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal11
: Ahem! I will be doing no such thing.
lines.zh: : 咳哼！我可不会做这种事。

lines.en: : Everyone knows that the most satisfying rewards are those that require a great amount of perseverance to achieve.
lines.zh: : 众所周知，最让人满足的奖励，是那些需要极大毅力才能获得的。

lines.en: : If we were to immediately jump to the grand finale, everything thereafter would be anticlimactic or pointless.
lines.zh: : 如果我们直接跳到大结局，那之后的一切都会变得索然无味、毫无意义。

lines.en: : Well at least now I know how the story ends.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少现在我知道故事的结局了。

lines.en: : So, when is this slumber party thing happening?
lines.zh: : 那么，这个睡衣派对什么时候办？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal12
: Is Saturday okay?
lines.zh: : 星期六可以吗？

lines.en: : Ami said she was going to ask you, but I really wanted to show off Tsuneyo’s new skill and this was a good opportunity to do both of those things at once.
lines.zh: : Ami 说她会去问你，但我实在很想炫耀一下 Tsuneyo 的新技能，而且这是一次能同时办成两件事的好机会。

lines.en: : Again, that {i}skill{/i} wasn’t really necessary.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，那个{i}技能{/i}真没什么必要。

lines.en: : My feelings are in pain now.
lines.zh: : 我的感情现在很痛。

lines.en: : You two can do whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 你们俩想干什么都行。

lines.en: : Hell, you can move in for all I care. I’m not going to say no to the presence of more girls.
lines.zh: : 妈的，你们搬进来住我都无所谓。有更多女孩在场，我不会说不愿意的。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal13
: Woo! Mission complete! One step closer to the next event CG!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！任务完成！离下一张活动 CG 又近了一步！

lines.en: : I’ll be in your care.
lines.zh: : 那就拜托您了。

lines.en: : I know that basically every night for me is a slumber party with Tsuneyo, but having one with everyone else around sounds even-
lines.zh: : 我知道对我来说，基本上每晚都是和 Tsuneyo 的睡衣派对，但和其他人一起办一场听起来更——

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal14
: Did someone say slumber party?
lines.zh: : 刚才有人说睡衣派对？

lines.en: : Gah!
lines.zh: : 呀啊！

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian did say those words. That is correct.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者确实说过这句话。没错。

lines.en: : Seven hells, Angel of Death. Ye nearly scared my skirt off.
lines.zh: : 七层地狱啊，死亡天使。你差点把我的裙子都吓掉了。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal15
: There is no need to fear me. I’m weak and pitiful and could be blown away by even the lightest gust of wind.
lines.zh: : 不必害怕我。我又弱又可怜，哪怕最轻微的一阵风都能把我吹走。

lines.en: : Hi, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Yasu。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal16
: Hehhhehahahehaehehehheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿哈哈嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Okay, good talk.
lines.zh: : 好的，聊得愉快。

lines.en: : A slumber party with so many fragile little girls...You’re not thinking of doing anything immoral, are you?
lines.zh: : 和这么多脆弱的小女孩办睡衣派对……你不是在打算做什么不道德的事吧？

lines.en: : The act of transference should be saved only for those willing to follow the light. Doing it mindlessly is simply a waste of energy.
lines.zh: : 传输这种行为，只该留给那些愿意追随光的人。毫无意识地去做，不过是浪费能量罢了。

lines.en: : Transference?...You mean like...mana transferring?
lines.zh: : 传输？……你是说像……魔力传输？

lines.en: : Mana what?
lines.zh: : 魔力什么？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal17
: Uh-oh! Looks like it’s time for another weebnote!
lines.zh: : 哦嚯！看来又到了御宅小课堂时间！

lines.en: : Transferring mana through sex is a popular trope in fantasy games and media reserved for dire situations where one character, on the brink of death, must be essentially screwed back to life!
lines.zh: : 通过性行为传输魔力，是奇幻游戏和媒体里很流行的桥段，专门留给那种生死攸关的场合——某个角色濒临死亡，必须被活活“做”回来！

lines.en: : It’s quite disturbing conceptually considering that people don’t normally do things like that while they’re knocking on death’s door, but hey! More h-scenes means more money!
lines.zh: : 从概念上讲，这挺让人不适的，毕竟正常人临死前是不会做那种事的，不过嘿！H 场景越多，赚的钱越多！

lines.en: : I have learned something today.
lines.zh: : 我今天学到了东西。

lines.en: : Does this sound similar to the type of transference you’re speaking of, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 这听起来和你说的是同一种传输吗，Yasu？

lines.en: : No. It sounds sinful and disgusting.
lines.zh: : 不。听起来既罪恶又恶心。

lines.en: : I bet you’re very excited to dive further into darkness...aren’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我敢说，你非常兴奋地想要进一步沉入黑暗……对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : To think that just recently you were finally beginning to see the light...
lines.zh: : 想想看，就在不久之前，你才终于开始看见光……

lines.en: : Do you intend to be led astray when I am so willing to shepherd you to the final destination?
lines.zh: : 我如此愿意把你引向终点，你却打算被引入歧途吗？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal18
: The end of days is upon us! You could have all of me anytime you want! And in turn, all of everyone else so willing to believe!
lines.zh: : 末日已经逼近！你想要我的全部，随时都可以取走！作为交换，所有愿意相信的人，也都可以归你所有！

lines.en: : Why surround yourself with temptation when the answer you seek is right in front of-
lines.zh: : 既然你寻求的答案就在眼前，又何必让自己被诱惑包围——

lines.en: : Yasu.
lines.zh: : Yasu。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal19
: Hi, Touka.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Touka。

lines.en: : What were you doing just now?
lines.zh: : 你刚才在做什么？

lines.en: : Nothing, Touka.
lines.zh: : 没做什么，Touka。

lines.en: : What did I tell you about indoctrinating people in the halls?
lines.zh: : 我怎么跟你说的，在走廊里给人洗脑？

lines.en: : That it’s inappropriate and I should wait until we're outside to show people the light.
lines.zh: : 说那样不得体，我应该等到外面去，再向人们展示光。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal20
: I sincerely apologize on behalf of my roommate. She truly doesn’t know any better.
lines.zh: : 我替我的室友由衷地道歉。她是真的不懂事。

lines.en: : I’m sure that an apology isn’t in order on account of you not being familiar with [kumon_mi_high]’s handbook and henceforth not understanding what {i}is{/i} and {i}isn’t{/i} allowed-
lines.zh: : 我相信，由于你不熟悉 [kumon_mi_high] 的手册，因而分不清什么{i}允许{/i}、什么{i}不允许{/i}，本是不需要道歉的——

lines.en: : But what she’s doing is a major infraction of[school] policy that I can, in no way, be affiliated with.
lines.zh: : 但她所做的事严重违反了[school]的规定，我无论如何都不能与之有任何牵连。

lines.en: : Have you been talking to Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你是不是跟 Makoto 聊过了？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal21
: Yes! I need {i}someone{/i} to teach me because my {i}teacher{/i} won’t!
lines.zh: : 是的！我需要{i}有人{/i}来教我，因为我的{i}老师{/i}不肯教！

lines.en: : Who is your teacher again?
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你的老师是谁来着？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal22
: I despise you with every fiber of my being.
lines.zh: : 我用我存在的每一根纤维憎恨着你。

lines.en: : Can we have our own slumber party, Touka?
lines.zh: : 我们能办自己的睡衣派对吗，Touka？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I may have ruined our opportunity to be invited to the manga club’s by allowing my beliefs to guide my speech yet again.
lines.zh: : 我担心，由于又一次让自己的信仰主导了言辞，我已经毁掉了我们被邀请去漫画社派对的机会。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal23
: Is that not what we do every night?
lines.zh: : 我们不是每晚都在做这件事吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ve never had friends before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我从没有过朋友。

lines.en: : Neither have I, but...I suppose we can be a bit more...festive about spending time in our room tonight, if that would make you happy.
lines.zh: : 我也没有，不过……我想，今晚待在房间里的时候，我们可以稍微……更有节日气氛一点，如果那样能让你开心的话。

lines.en: : Just being with you is enough to make me happy, Touka. You’re so pretty and wonderful.
lines.zh: : 只要和你在一起，就足够让我开心了，Touka。你又漂亮又美好。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal24
: Heheh...I suppose I am.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……我想我确实是。

lines.en: : Now, come, Yasu. And stop wandering off every time I take my eyes off of you.
lines.zh: : 好了，走吧，Yasu。别每次我一转眼你就到处乱跑。

lines.en: : Yes, Touka. I’m so very sorry.
lines.zh: : 好的，Touka。我非常抱歉。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal25
: Am I the only person who thought that was strange?
lines.zh: : 只有我觉得刚才那幕很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Nope, I’m pretty sure we all did.
lines.zh: : 不。不，我敢肯定我们都这么觉得。

lines.en: : I think they make a good couple.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她们挺般配的。

lines.en: : Kind of like a...more intense version of you two.
lines.zh: : 有点像……你们俩的加强版。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal26
: You think Tsuneyo and I are like them?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我和 Tsuneyo 像她们？

lines.en: : In the fact that all four of you are weird and I never know what any of you are talking about, yes.
lines.zh: : 就你们四个都很怪、而且我永远听不懂你们任何人在说什么这一点而言，是的。

lines.en: : All I know is noodles.
lines.zh: : 我只懂面条。

lines.en: : All Yasu knows is her weird god.
lines.zh: : 而 Yasu 只懂她那个奇怪的神。

lines.en: : Touka isn’t secretly into games and anime and stuff too, is she? Because we’re looking to recruit new members and-
lines.zh: : Touka 该不会也偷偷喜欢游戏和动漫什么的吧？因为我们正在招新成员，而且——

lines.en: : I...don’t know if she’s ever even watched anything like that. But you’re both...passionate about your interests, at least.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道她有没有看过那类东西。但你们俩……至少对自己的爱好都很有热情。

lines.en: : You should try talking to them a little more. Maybe even inviting them to the slumber party thing.
lines.zh: : 你们应该试着多跟她们聊聊。也许甚至邀请她们来这个睡衣派对。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal27
: Perhaps next time! We’ve already made the necessary preparations for the coming one and I get very stressed when things do not go according to plan!
lines.zh: : 也许下次吧！这一次的必要准备我们都已经做好了，而事情不按计划进行的时候，我会非常有压力！

lines.en: And so my attempt at getting more pajama-clothed girls gathered in one place comes to an end.
lines.zh: 就这样，我想把更多穿着睡衣的女孩聚到一处地方的努力，就此告终。

lines.en: I suppose I’ll just have to make do with the manga club and-
lines.zh: 我想我只能将就着跟漫画社一起——

lines.en: : Wait, is Tsuneyo even in the manga club?
lines.zh: : 等等，Tsuneyo 根本不在漫画社吧？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal28
: She is not. But the dark entity living within the second floor of the dorm beckons her to accompany me to the...less dark sections of the map!
lines.zh: : 她不在。但住在宿舍二楼的那个黑暗实体在召唤她，要她陪我去地图上……不那么黑暗的区域！

lines.en: : I feel uncomfortable staying in the dorm room alone.
lines.zh: : 我一个人待在宿舍房间里会觉得不舒服。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian has too many action figures and they all stare at me while I am trying to sleep.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者有太多手办，我睡觉的时候它们全都盯着我看。

lines.en: : It takes a great deal of energy preventing myself from attacking them, but I have been informed of their value on several occasions now and could not bring myself to destroy them knowing that.
lines.zh: : 阻止自己去攻击它们，要花很大的力气，但我已经多次被告知它们的价值，知道这些之后，我下不了手毁掉它们。

lines.en: : That and I’m still trying to get Tsuneyo into gaming and stuff. She’s just...really, really bad with technology.
lines.zh: : 还有，我也一直在努力把 Tsuneyo 拉进游戏之类的坑里。她只是……真的、真的非常不擅长科技产品。

lines.en: : That’s fine. So is Yumi and she’s still a relatively functional human being.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Yumi 也一样，可她还算是个功能正常的人。

lines.en: : I know how to work a cash register.
lines.zh: : 我会用收银机。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that will get you very far in life. Good job, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这能让你在人生道路上走得很远。干得好，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Thanks, man.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，老兄。

lines.en: : So, everything is good to go then? You’re fine with us making lots of noise and staying up all night?
lines.zh: : 那么，一切都谈妥了？你同意我们大吵大闹、通宵不睡？

lines.en: : Sure. I have one condition, though.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过我有一个条件。

lines.en: : Understood! What is it, Sir?
lines.zh: : 明白！是什么，长官？

lines.en: : Everyone has to sleep in my room.
lines.zh: : 所有人都得睡在我的房间里。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal29
: Then where will you sleep?
lines.zh: : 那您睡哪儿？

lines.en: : Also my room.
lines.zh: : 也睡我的房间。

lines.en: : Oh.
: No thank you.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Is there...even enough room for everyone in there?
lines.zh: : 房间里……真的装得下所有人吗？

lines.en: : If we all get really close together, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果我们挨得足够近的话，装得下。

lines.en: : I already said no. Go away.
lines.zh: : 我已经说了不要。一边去。

lines.en: : I would sooner be killed by the action figures.
lines.zh: : 我宁可被那些手办杀死。

lines.en: : I...don’t know if I can accept those terms, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道我能不能接受这些条件，长官。

lines.en: : I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t at least a little bit interested, but...everyone else will be there and...
lines.zh: : 如果我说自己一点兴趣都没有，那是在撒谎，但是……其他人也都在场，而且……

lines.en: : I was kidding.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : There’s no way Ami would ever allow that anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正 Ami 也绝不可能允许那种事。

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal30
: Oh! Hahah! Right! I knew that!
lines.zh: : 哦！哈哈哈！对！我早就知道的！

lines.en: : Your face is getting red. You should have listened to me and worn warmer clothing.
lines.zh: : 你的脸红了。你该听我的，穿得暖和点。

lines.en: : Now you’re going to get sick and die and I will be left all alone.
lines.zh: : 现在你要生病死掉了，而我会被一个人留在这世上。

lines.en: : Well I’m...sorry in advance if that happens.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我……如果真发生了，先说声抱歉。

lines.en: : But...since we’ve had our plan approved and you’ve gotten to showcase your newfound acting talent, we should probably be leaving Sir alone.
lines.zh: : 不过……既然我们的计划已经获批，你也展示了你新发现的表演才能，我们大概该让长官一个人待着了。

lines.en: : We’ve already taken up too much of his time and...he already said he has...doors to knock on and...we all know how doors can be...
lines.zh: : 我们已经占用了他太多的时间，而且……他说了他还有……门要敲，而且……我们都知道门有多……

lines.en: : Do we?
lines.zh: : 我们知道吗？

lines.en: scene mollytsuneyoproposal31
: A-Anyway! Prepare for us to invade your domain this coming weekend!
lines.zh: : 总——总之！准备好迎接我们在这个周末入侵您的领地吧！

lines.en: : And please refrain from saying anything during the encounter that will make me look like this!
lines.zh: : 还有，请在那场遭遇战期间，别说任何会让我变成这副模样的话！

lines.en: : Feckin’ Irish skin is always revealin’ my true feelings and I didn’t sign off on that at all!
lines.zh: : 该死的爱尔兰皮肤总是把我的真实感情暴露出来，我可完全没同意过这一点！

lines.en: : How many noodles are in your house?
lines.zh: : 你家里有多少面条？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Well, we will soon find out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们很快就会知道了。

lines.en: : Thank you for your service.
lines.zh: : 感谢您的服务。

lines.en: scene black
: ...What service?
lines.zh: : ……什么服务？

lines.en: The two of them wander off and I’m finally free to get on with the rest of my day.
lines.zh: 她们俩走开了，我终于可以继续度过这一天剩下的时间。

lines.en: I’m not sure exactly when the next reset is supposed to happen, but...I do hope I get to at least see the slumber party thing before it does.
lines.zh: 我不确定下一次重置具体会在什么时候发生，不过……我真的希望在它到来之前，至少能看到那场睡衣派对。

lines.en: It would be a shame to miss out on something like that in favor of...whatever the hell is going to happen on the rooftop this time around.
lines.zh: 要是错过了那种事，换来的却是这次天台上将要发生的不知道什么鬼东西，那可太可惜了。

lines.en: As Molly and Tsuneyo disappear around the corner, I slide my hands into my pockets and head for the stairs.
lines.zh: Molly 和 Tsuneyo 消失在拐角处，我把双手插进兜里，朝楼梯走去。

lines.en: I wonder what door I’ll be knocking on today.
lines.zh: 我在想，今天我会敲开哪一扇门。
